sql.value: select ao.id, ao.name_original, ao.name_cn, ao.cover_url, ao.detail_info_url, ao.episodes, ao.launch_start, ao.delivery_week, ao.ani_summary, ao.has_resource, ao.rss_url, ao.rss_status, ao.rss_level_index, ao.rss_file_type, ao.rss_only_mark, ao.rss_exclude_res, ao.create_by, ao.create_time, ao.update_time, ao.update_by from ani_opus ao where ao.is_deleted = 0 #[and ao.name_cn = :nameCn] #[and ao.name_cn like :likeNameCn] #[and ao.name_original = :nameOriginal] #[and ao.name_original like :likeNameOriginal] #[and ao.rss_status = :rssStatus] #[and ao.has_resource = :hasResource] #[and ao.detail_info_url = :detailUrl] order by ao.id desc

select ao.id, ao.name_original, ao.name_cn, ao.cover_url, ao.detail_info_url, ao.episodes, ao.launch_start, ao.delivery_week, ao.ani_summary, ao.score, ao.has_resource, ao.rss_url, ao.rss_status, ao.rss_level_index, ao.rss_file_type, ao.rss_only_mark, ao.rss_exclude_res, ao.create_time,ao.update_time, ao.create_by as createByName, ao.update_by as updateByName from ani_opus ao where ao.is_deleted = 0 #[and ao.name_cn = :nameCn] #[and ao.name_cn like :likeNameCn] #[and ao.name_original = :nameOriginal] #[and ao.name_original like :likeNameOriginal] #[and ao.rss_status = :rssStatus] #[and ao.has_resource = :hasResource] #[and ao.detail_info_url = :detailUrl] order by ao.id desc

select ao.id, ao.name_original, ao.name_cn, ao.cover_url, ao.detail_info_url, ao.episodes, ao.launch_start, ao.delivery_week, ao.ani_summary, ao.has_resource, ao.rss_url, ao.rss_status, ao.rss_level_index, ao.rss_file_type, ao.rss_only_mark, ao.rss_exclude_res, ao.media_count, ao.media_latest_key, auo.read_status, auo.user_id, case when auo.id is null then 0 else 1 end as is_follow, auo.last_episode_key, auo.last_media_id, (select count(1) from ani_user_opus_progress p where p.user_id = :loginId and p.opus_id = ao.id and p.is_deleted = 0 and p.is_completed = 1 and exists (select 1 from ani_media m where m.opus_id = ao.id and m.is_deleted = 0 and m.is_primary = 1 and m.episode_key = p.episode_key)) as completed_count, (select p.position_ms from ani_user_opus_progress p where p.user_id = :loginId and p.opus_id = ao.id and p.is_deleted = 0 and p.episode_key = auo.last_episode_key limit 1) as position_ms, (select p.duration_ms from ani_user_opus_progress p where p.user_id = :loginId and p.opus_id = ao.id and p.is_deleted = 0 and p.episode_key = auo.last_episode_key limit 1) as duration_ms, (select case when count(1) > 0 then 1 else 0 end from ani_user_opus_progress p where p.user_id = :loginId and p.opus_id = ao.id and p.is_deleted = 0 and p.is_completed = 1 and p.episode_key = ao.media_latest_key) as latest_episode_completed, (select m.display_name from ani_media m where m.opus_id = ao.id and m.is_deleted = 0 and m.is_primary = 1 and m.episode_key = ao.media_latest_key order by m.id limit 1) as episodes_newest from ani_opus ao left join ani_user_opus auo on (auo.opus_id = ao.id and auo.user_id = :loginId) where ao.is_deleted = 0 and (:followFlag = 0 or auo.id is not null) and (:unfollowFlag = 0 or auo.id is null) #[and ao.has_resource = :hasResource] #[and (ao.name_cn like :searchKey or ao.name_original like :searchKey)] #[and ao.id in (:opusIds)] #[and ao.delivery_week in (:deliveryWeeks)] #[and ( year(date_format(str_to_date(ao.launch_start, '%Y年%m月%d日'), '%Y-%m-%d')) in (:years) or year(date_format(ao.launch_start, '%Y-%m-%d')) in (:years) )] #[and ( month(date_format(str_to_date(ao.launch_start, '%Y年%m月%d日'), '%Y-%m-%d')) in (:months) or month(date_format(launch_start, '%Y-%m-%d')) in (:months) )] #[and auo.read_status in (:status)] order by auo.last_read_time desc, ao.id desc
select count(1) from ani_opus where is_deleted = 0 #[and rss_status = :rssStatus]
